label: Digital Identity Management
definition: Problem space concerned with representing, establishing, administering, authenticating, authorizing, exchanging and governing digital identities across heterogeneous ecosystems.
scope: All CM4DI in-scope digital-identity semantics and integration views.
exclusions: Social Identity as psychosocial selfhood; full cybersecurity; full privacy law ontology.
legacy_lineage: Successor organizational frame for the mixed Wave-5 semantic-domain list.

label: Identity Representation
definition: Defines what entity is represented or identified and how a managed digital identity, identifier and identity context represent that entity.
exclusions: Account administration; federation; social identity; trust infrastructure.
legacy_lineage: Refines former Identity Subjecthood and Digital Representation clusters.

label: Identity Information
definition: Defines identity-related information and assertions about identity subjects.
scope: IdentityAttribute; Claim and their semantic interpretation.
exclusions: Evidence evaluation; credential lifecycle; attribute synchronization mechanics.

label: Identity Evidence
definition: Defines evidential roles, proof use, subject-representation binding and assurance assessment used to support identity assertions and decisions.
scope: Evidence; Proof; IdentityBinding; AssuranceAssessment; generic Verifier role.
exclusions: Identity proofing workflow itself; cryptographic mechanisms; governance certification.
legacy_lineage: Refines former Evidence/Provenance and Trust/Assurance Core hooks.

label: Identity Establishment
definition: Defines processes that establish confidence in an identity subject and create a managed identity relationship or representation.
legacy_lineage: Successor to former Proofing and Enrollment cluster.

label: Credential Management
definition: Defines credential issuance, status and lifecycle independently from presentation technology.
exclusions: Wallet operation; presentation; session; generic identity proofing.
legacy_lineage: Refines former Credential Semantics and profile issuer semantics.

label: Authentication
definition: Defines verification of an actor or control of an authenticator and the resulting authentication outcome and session relationship.
exclusions: Identity proofing; federation governance; authorization decisions.
legacy_lineage: Refines former Authentication cluster and P01 Session.

label: Authorization
definition: Defines access requests, principals, resources, actions, permissions, grants, delegation, policies and authorization decisions.
scope: Authorization kernel plus permission bundles, access policies, conditions and operational access groups.
exclusions: Authentication; sociological groups; full policy-language ontology.
legacy_lineage: Refines former Authorization cluster and P01 access-management constructs.

label: Identity Administration
definition: Defines platform-local administration of accounts, profiles, identity sources, stores, applications, provisioning and attribute mappings.
scope: Account; UserProfile; IdentitySource; IdentityStore; AdministrativeDomain; Application; Provisioning; AttributeMapping.
exclusions: Federation relationship semantics; proofing; authorization policy semantics.
legacy_lineage: Splits former Federation and Provisioning profile area.

label: Federation
definition: Defines cross-domain identity relationships, federation connections, brokers and relying interactions across independently administered identity domains.
exclusions: Account provisioning; wallet presentation; trust-framework governance itself.
legacy_lineage: Splits former Federation and Provisioning profile area.

label: Credential Exchange
definition: Defines holding, requesting, controlling, selectively disclosing and presenting credential-derived information to verifiers.
scope: Holder; Wallet; HolderService; CredentialPresentation; PresentationRequest; Controller; VerificationMethod; VerifiableDataRegistry; SelectiveDisclosure; VerifiablePresentation.
exclusions: Credential issuance lifecycle; generic authentication; government legal identity.
legacy_lineage: Successor problem-space domain underlying former Wallet / VC profile view.

label: Workload Identity
definition: Defines identity of runtime workloads and service principals, workload attestation, trust domains and short-lived workload credentials.
scope: Workload; RuntimeInstance; ServiceAccount; ServicePrincipal; ManagedIdentity; NodeAttestation; WorkloadAttestation; TrustDomain; TrustBundle; SVID; TemporaryCredential; TokenExchange.
exclusions: Physical device identity; autonomous agent governance; generic human account administration.
legacy_lineage: Split from former Machine Identity and P03 technical profile view.

label: Device Identity
definition: Defines devices as identity-bearing entities and their managed identity records while preserving separation from authenticator roles and credentials.
exclusions: Workload execution identity; device credential mechanisms; generic authenticator ontology.
legacy_lineage: Split from former Machine Identity and P03 technical profile view.

label: Agent Identity
definition: Defines software and AI agents as identity-bearing and authorization-capable entities with managed agent identities and accountable sponsors.
exclusions: General AI ontology; social identity; generic workload identity unless explicitly mapped.
legacy_lineage: Split from former Machine Identity and P03 technical profile view.

label: Trust Governance
definition: Defines trust assessments, external trust references, governance frameworks, registries, anchors, institutional roles, conformance processes and participation status.
scope: TrustAssessment; TrustReference; TrustFramework; GovernanceFramework; TrustRegistry; TrustedList; TrustAnchor; TrustChain; governance roles; Certification; Accreditation; EcosystemParticipation; ParticipantStatus.
exclusions: Cryptographic algorithms; social/interpersonal trust theory; government identity data itself.
legacy_lineage: Refines former Trust and Assurance plus Government / Institutional Trust clusters while separating governance from legal identity.

label: Government Identity
definition: Defines legally recognized identity constructs, person-identification data, government attestations and governed identity-service-provider roles.
exclusions: General trust-framework governance; complete public-administration ontology; civil-registry domain details.
legacy_lineage: Split from former Government / Institutional Trust profile area.
